Bash(gh pr create --title "Migrate jido_htn to Zoi schemas" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Summary

Migrates `jido_htn` from raw Elixir structs to Zoi schemas for validated, type-safe data structures. This aligns with the broader Jido ecosystem''s move toward Zoi schemas.

## Changes

- Added Zoi 0.14 as a dependency
- Migrated 6 structs to Zoi schemas:
  - `MethodTraversalRecord`
  - `Domain.Builder`
  - `Method`
  - `CompoundTask`
  - `PrimitiveTask`
  - `Domain`
- All constructors now return `{:ok, t\(\)} | {:error, term\(\)}` instead of structs
- Added `new!` raising variants for convenience
- Updated builder helpers to use `new!/` variants internally
- Updated all tests to handle new constructor signatures

## Benefits

- Runtime validation at struct creation time
- Better error messages from Zoi
- Type specs auto-generated from schemas
- Consistent with jido, jido_action, and other Jido ecosystem libraries

## Test Results

All 218 tests passing.
